title_en: The Conduct of the Student of Sacred Knowledge
body_ar:
ألقى سماحة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بموريتانيا زوال اليوم الأربعاء 10 محرم 1438هـ الموافق: 12-10-2016م محاضرة بعنوان: "سلوك طالب العلم" بمدرج مركز تكوين العلماء لصالح مجموعة من الطلاب الجدد بالمركز في إطار أنشطة الدورة التكوينية التي يخضعون لها منذ أيام بإشراف مباشر من إدارة التربية بالمركز، وقد تطرق الشيخ خلال هذه المحاضرة لأهمية طلب العلم وفضله، مستعرضا الآيات

والأحاديث الواردة في هذا السياق، كما حث فضيلته الطلاب المشاركين في الدورة على ضرورة التحلي بجملة من الآداب والسلوك التي قال إنها لا بد أن يتصف بها طالب العلم، بدءا بإخلاص النية لله سبحانه وتعالى مع التواضع وحسن الصلة والمعاملة مع الناس قاطبة سواء كانوا من مشايخه أو أساتذته أو حتى زملائه، موضحا أن هذا هو الطريق الصحيح والأضمن لتحصيل العلم الذي هو في الحقيقة استعلاء ثمنه التعب والمشقة، وأن طالب العلم يحتاج إلى قدر كبير من التحمل والصبر خلال مشواره الدراسي مقتفيا بذلك أثر السلف الصالح من الأئمة والعلماء الأجلاء الذين ذاقوا الأمرين و ذللوا الصعاب في سبيل التحصيل العلمي، مشددا على أن الغاية من طلب العلم هو تطبيقه والعمل به وتعليمه للناس بعيدا عن مخالفته أو الجدال به، وأن الأمة اليوم تحتاج في كل مكان إلى علماء ربانيين مخلصين يوجهونها ويرشدونها إلى جادة الصواب في كافة أمورها الدينية والدنيوية.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars in Mauritania, delivered just after noon this Wednesday, 10 Muharram 1438 AH, corresponding to 12-10-2016, a lecture entitled 'The Conduct of the Student of Sacred Knowledge', in the lecture hall of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, for a group of the Centre's new students, as part of the activities of the induction course they have been undergoing for some days under the direct supervision of the Centre's department of formation.

In the course of this lecture the Sheikh touched on the importance of seeking sacred knowledge and its merit, surveying the verses and the hadiths that bear on this. His Eminence also urged the students taking part in the course to adorn themselves with a set of manners and conduct which, he said, a student of sacred knowledge must have: beginning with sincerity of intention (ikhlāṣ) towards God, glorified and exalted, together with humility and good relations and dealings with people at large, whether they be his sheikhs, his teachers, or even his fellow students. He explained that this is the sound and surest road to the attainment of knowledge, which is in truth an elevation whose price is toil and hardship; and that the student of sacred knowledge needs a great measure of endurance and patience over the course of his studies, following in this the trace of the righteous forebears among the imams and the eminent scholars, who tasted bitterness and subdued difficulties for the sake of attaining knowledge. He stressed that the purpose of seeking knowledge is to apply it, to act upon it and to teach it to people, far from contravening it or using it for disputation; and that the community today needs everywhere sincere, godly scholars to direct it and guide it to the straight path in all its affairs, religious and worldly.

flags.arabic: العلم الذي هو في الحقيقة استعلاء ثمنه التعب والمشقة
flags.context: the Sheikh's account of why the student must be humble
options: knowledge, which is in truth an elevation whose price is toil and hardship
knowledge, which is in reality a raising up, paid for with weariness and hardship
knowledge, which is in fact a loftiness bought at the cost of exertion and hardship
flags.note: استعلاء is normally pejorative in Arabic — haughtiness, setting oneself above others — which sits oddly beside the call to humility in the same sentence. Read here in its literal sense of being raised up, which is what the contrast with 'price' requires. The report is the site's paraphrase, so the Sheikh's own word cannot be recovered; the rendering should not be fixed without the recording.

mashaqqah is a glossary term with a technical use in legal theory (the hardship that occasions a dispensation). Here it is used in its ordinary, non-technical sense of the effort study costs, and must not be read as invoking the legal threshold.

translator_notes: A news report written by the site; the lecture itself is not transcribed. Only the site's summary of it exists here.
طالب العلم is the student of the religious sciences specifically; rendered 'student of sacred knowledge' to keep that.
'إدارة التربية' is rendered 'the department of formation', matching the Centre's own use of تكوين for the training of scholars.
The paragraph break in the middle of 'مستعرضا الآيات / والأحاديث' is an artefact of the page markup, not a break in the sentence.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, not the date of composition.
